```{python}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: Dependencies
import sys, os
sys.path.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..", "..")))

from caipe_sim.three_level_model import run_sim
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
```

## Run default simulation

```{python}
%%time
times, n_pop, g_pop, e_pop, s_pop = run_sim(t_steps=200)
```

## Plot simulation

```{python}
plt.plot(times, n_pop, label="Photon numbers")
plt.plot(times, g_pop, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, e_pop, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, s_pop, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, g_pop + e_pop + s_pop, label="Total population")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

## Parameter sweeps

```{python}
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import sweep_parameters
constants = {
  "gamma": 0.05,
  "kappa": 0.2,
  "rabi": 2.0,
  "gval": 1.0,
  "detune_c": 1.0,
  "detune_l": 1.0,
  "Ncav": 4,
}
```

### $\kappa$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
kappa_range = np.linspace(0.01, 1, 100)
kap_g, kap_e, kap_s, kap_photon = sweep_parameters('kappa', kappa_range, constants.copy())
```

```{python}
plt.plot(kappa_range, kap_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(kappa_range, kap_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(kappa_range, kap_s, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(kappa_range, kap_photon, label="Photon population")
plt.title("Kappa sweep")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

### $\gamma$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
gamma_range = np.linspace(0.01, 1, 100)
gam_g, gam_e, gam_s, gam_photon = sweep_parameters('gamma', gamma_range, constants.copy())
```

```{python}
plt.plot(gamma_range, gam_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(gamma_range, gam_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(gamma_range, gam_s, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(gamma_range, gam_photon, label="Photon population")
plt.title("Gamma sweep")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

### Rabi sweep

```{python}
rabi_range = np.linspace(0.01, 1, 100)
rabi_g, rabi_e, rabi_s, rabi_photon = sweep_parameters('rabi', rabi_range, constants.copy())
```

```{python}
plt.plot(rabi_range, rabi_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(rabi_range, rabi_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(rabi_range, rabi_s, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(rabi_range, rabi_photon, label="Photon population")
plt.title("Rabi sweep")
plt.show()
```

### $g$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
gval_range = np.linspace(0.01, 1, 100)
gval_g, gval_e, gval_s, gval_photon = sweep_parameters('gval', gval_range, constants.copy())
```

```{python}
plt.plot(gval_range, gval_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(gval_range, gval_e, label="|e⟩ poopulation")
```
